title: 鸣潮战斗系统共同接口与测试基线

decisions.title: 实体和来源
decisions.decision: 玩家1个body_id，1份HP、基础面板、装备和共享手牌；1至3个不同role_id模板，恰好0或1个激活模板（开场中立）。模板不是实体；人形机兵不是第二个实体。同角色NPC与模板可有不同entity_id，但贡献按同一character_ability_source去重。
decisions.rationale: 保持一身体和实际来源协作；独立NPC只作明确扩展

decisions.title: 初始预算
decisions.decision: 每个玩家回合能量设为3（不结转）；新增抽5，不是补至5；手牌上限10。模态0费，正常出牌弃置；模态本身不产协奏、私池、熟练、抽牌、护盾或返费。只有已满协奏的有效交接可另外结算已学变奏/延奏；重复当前模态绝无此例外。首次有效激活仅安装已取得映射及规则。
decisions.rationale: 保留牌位、到手时机和供牌机会成本，同时不另造切换CD；3/5不是原作值也不是沿袭旧稿即正确

decisions.title: 自由构筑
decisions.decision: 初始可编辑；出战牌组1至30张，实体卡副本不超过收藏中的owned_copy_count且同card_definition最多3。模态收藏首次给1实体副本，通用A/D起始各5份，可自选0至3份；每次学新技能给1份其卡式，追加实体副本须另有取得凭证。可0攻击、可不带模态、可全防/全模态；没有强制比例或玩家类型。
decisions.rationale: 有限收藏防无限复制；合法性与强度分开，完全无伤害亦可合法失败

decisions.title: 首得和后学
decisions.decision: 首次模板只新增模态卡，且取得该模板通用A/D的内在机械映射及所需有限基础私池。五角色首得就有不同决定，不能仅换元素/名称。未学E/H/R、变奏、延奏、两固有和高级回路仍不可用；学习增加收藏但不改decklist。
decisions.rationale: 保证学习选择与收藏/配置/战场分层

decisions.title: 共同共享资源
decisions.decision: energy为本轮3费预算，concerto为跨轮0至6共享接力进度；不另加全员通用解放能量条。解放卡用已明示energy/私池/阶段成本，各版不得偷偷造第三公共强制量。私池切出保留，战斗结束清理。
decisions.rationale: 共享资源各有时间用途；删原作无意义逐秒量

decisions.title: 重复当前模态
decisions.decision: 合法打出，支付印制费用（本轮0），弃置实体卡；无MODE_SWITCHED，不触发离场/入场/装备/协奏/固有/成长，不能重置任何次数或期限。记为ineffective_mode_play。
decisions.rationale: 不奖励重复、不藏兜底；无效操作不计有效行动

decisions.title: 贡献去重
decisions.decision: character_ability_source=role_id；真实合格事件后记录该来源，而非看装了谁。震谐需INTERFERENCE_DAMAGE且hp_lost>0；聚爆需FUSION_APPLIED且accepted_stacks>0。只认player_skill、npc_skill或由已学技能实际建立的deployment；装备自身、纯扩容、纯治疗、纯模式不计。
decisions.rationale: 区分实际合作与名单加成；人形机兵同源，千咲扩容不算施加

decisions.title: 协作轨迹
decisions.decision: 仅已学爱弥斯第二固有且本场装入爱弥斯时启用两份来源集合；本场开始空，不追溯学习前事件。震谐门槛3不同来源，聚爆门槛2；本人可各计1。切出/换路线不清；选路R2完成后只消费该路集合。其他路保留至兑现/终战；来源死亡不撤销历史贡献。
decisions.rationale: 沿保留原不同阈值方向，单模板仍可完整基础终结，只不满团队收益；无需真NPC才能测三来源

decisions.title: 压缩而非照抄
decisions.decision: 本批每模板最多2个私有数值维度，分别登记可消费池和不可消费历史量；最多3个真实独立分类轴（如爱弥斯形态、过载阶段、路线），每轴不超过4态；两个独立取得固有。隐藏或合并显示不减维数。若压缩无法保住已验收身份，必须回第四步登记例外、审阅并复测共同基线，不能由候选或实现者暗删身份。
decisions.rationale: 预算是本轮工程约束，不是人类最佳容量定律

decisions.title: 统一基本数值
decisions.decision: 早中晚HP=100/150/220，ATK=10/15/22，DEF=0；中立A费用1伤害1.0ATK，中立D费用1格挡0.8ATK。首次角色映射同费1但以公开的准备、消费、延后和限定防护改变用途，具体本轮暂定系数见fresh_mode_mapping，不能只换颜色。
decisions.rationale: 先用少乘区可复算基线识别角色机制；装备/成长各有独立账本

decisions.title: 敌人意图
decisions.decision: 每轮开始前公开下轮将执行的确切能力、目标规则、次数、基础伤害和修正来源；锁定intent_id和ability_id，敌人不读玩家手牌换招。仅公开控制/阶段事件能改动意图，并产意图修订记录。
decisions.rationale: 信息足以支撑取舍，避免临场补能力

decisions.title: 无固定切换冷却
decisions.decision: 只由手牌、已取得模板及本次行动费用限制切换；同轮可以A到B到A。次数上限是牌流结果，不能另加一轮一次或冷却。
decisions.rationale: 遵守取消旧CD，防止用性能护栏冒充玩法CD

decisions.title: 预注册口径澄清
decisions.decision: fresh_acquisition首得检查允许模态内在A/D机械映射和有限基础私池，不包含独立E/H/R、变奏延奏及两后学固有。early_post_intro另外要求已取得高级回路与2主动的凭证；均非本体等级自动发放。
decisions.rationale: 分开首得检查与有真实学习记录的早期战斗快照，禁止用同名early偷赠成长

identity_model.npc_scope: 当前450格主矩阵均player_bodies=1,npc_bodies=0；二三人协作指2/3模板真实行动接力。NPC本阶段冻结数据与来源接口，后续至少用能力目录stub验实体区别与同源去重；不宣称完整NPC模拟完成。
identity_model.equipment_owner: body_id，模板仅引用；不得每模板另挂并叠加loadout

card_schema.temporary: origin=generated不入永久收藏；本场exhaust不是删除收藏；无免费全局生成/回收操作
card_schema.generic_attack: COMMON_A为已拥有通用技能，1能量。中立分支1.0ATK；角色激活后按fresh_mode_mapping内在分支或后来已学扩展映射，在支付前绑定本次来源。映射不同不是额外实体卡，不自动授予E/H/R。
card_schema.generic_defend: COMMON_D为已拥有通用技能，1能量。中立0.8ATK格挡；角色内在映射可用有限准备换明确防护，保持防御职责不临场改攻击。映射或新学习的混合效果须预先列明。
card_schema.cross_template: 专属牌默认owner_is_active；候选可明写off_template分支与成本/缩窄效果，否则拒绝，不自动变白板攻击；来源仍原owner

keywords.retain: 由已学来源主动授予具体实例；默认至下个玩家回合结束一次，占手牌位；需额外资源或牺牲效应，不能单凭手牌位声称足够成本
keywords.exhaust: 从resolving移本场exhaust，不能通常洗回；只声明来源可取回，有限次数且不得重置原卡once标记
keywords.ethereal: 未打出且在手时回合末移exhaust；用于临时干扰，不删收藏
keywords.deploy: 卡进deployed且成为唯一场对象，不能同时弃置；默认总部署容量2，替换须指定原对象并放弃其剩余效应
keywords.draw: 源效果写明数量，先移实例后取下一张；上限之外的抽取终止，不弃一抽一
keywords.discard: 基础回合末弃置不是可自由手动弃牌按钮；技能弃牌可选择/随机须明示
keywords.cost_policy: 关键词本身不赠权限或零费；每个卡/节点/装备定义实际成本、次数、时点和失效

cost_schema.consume_tokens: explicit instance IDs or declared choice selectors
cost_schema.hp_cost: forbidden in common baseline; no hidden debt

loadout_validation.first_acquisition: 唯一取得凭证给一张模态实体卡，并解锁其fresh_mode_mapping规则和所需有限基础资源；不额外送主动牌、两固有、变奏/延奏；重复角色给通用技能+1道具。

start_battle: clear energy/concerto/private battle pools/temporary statuses and source sets
active_template=null; hp supplied by encounter fixture or campaign (never healed by template count)
shuffle deck; no guaranteed mode, no mulligan
player_turn_start: expire player_block and round-bound effects from prior cycle
draw 5 up to hand10; no fill-to-five assumption
publish already selected current enemy intents
resolve declared start-turn deployments in priority order
round_protocol.player_phase: zero or more validated root actions, including end_turn or retreat; no universal attack/dodge skill menu
end_player: discard unretained hand; consume retention expiry as specified; resolve ethereal before normal discard
future NPC ability slots (if configured) by stable entity_id
enemy abilities by declared initiative then entity_id, each one primary catalogue ability
create and publish next round intents
round_protocol.block_lifetime: player block gained in own turn remains through ensuing enemy phase and expires at next player_turn_start; shields have separately declared finite duration/uses; switching neither clears nor refreshes either

draw_rules.empty_draw: shuffle discard via keyed deterministic RNG and continue; resolving/deployed/exhaust never included
draw_rules.empty_both: draw fewer; no fatigue damage or generated safety card
draw_rules.hand_overflow: stop further requested draws; remaining unrequested cards stay draw; no compensation
draw_rules.end_hand: unretained discard; retention is instance token and max2 retained instances/body, source costs still required

deployment_rules.same_key: replace rather than stack; old card goes discard unless exhaust_on_leave; no refund
deployment_rules.activation: created during an event cannot listen to that same event unless definition explicitly gives on_deploy effect
deployment_rules.departure: skill-owned deployment persists when template switches unless declaration states owner_exit expiry; damage retains original owner/stats policy
deployment_rules.stats_snapshot: off-field damage/heal snapshots source ATK and skill level at creation; target mitigation reads current target; temporary buffs apply only if snapshot flags explicitly include them
deployment_rules.termination: remaining_uses integer0..3 or explicit round expiry<=3; no immortal automatic field in common profile
deployment_rules.retreat: no further field ticks after terminal

energy.grant_policy: only declared finite source; accepted=min(requested,10-current); overflow logged lost

concerto.qualifying: once per paid action/deploy root action with at least one of hp damage>0, new block/shield>0, actual heal>0, accepted private resource>0, accepted fusion/resonance progress>0, or created nonempty finite deployment; cost.energy_paid>=1 OR private_resource_spent>0; pure phase/route/template change never qualifies
concerto.additional_sources: candidate may declare at most+1 additional concerto/root action from learned inherent or equipment finite per-round trigger; no trigger recursively gains from CONCERTO_GAINED

private.switch: retain exact current state; no periodic off-field decay in common baseline
private.overflow: saturate to cap, emit lost amount, no draw/heal substitution
private.pay: no debt, no spending other template pool; validate full cost before mutation
private.learned_start_bonus: once per battle from learned source, registered battle_start token, not on template activation
private.phase_exit: deliberate named finisher may consume/clear specified owner resource; ordinary template switch never calls phase_exit
private.first_mode_intrinsic: fresh_mode_mapping声明的基础资源从首得可用，初值0；高级私池/上限/阶段需实际后学。模态切入本身不生成或刷新资源。

full_concerto_switch.eligible: target template differs AND old_active_template nonnull AND concerto==6 at pre-action snapshot
full_concerto_switch.first_activation: no outro/intro even if external fixture erroneously supplies6; regular mapping only
sequence: reserve and subtract6 before any exit trigger
snapshot old template outgoing learned effect and chosen target
remove old next-template grants that expire on exit
resolve old learned outro and its target-bound grant
if body terminal cancel remaining effects
set active template=target and emit MODE_SWITCHED
full_concerto_switch.unlearned: if a side has not learned its outro/intro that side resolves no effect; no free substitution; consume remains6
full_concerto_switch.not_full: switch and no intro/outro; concerto unchanged
full_concerto_switch.carry_over: post-consumption gains, if a specifically declared nonrecursive effect grants them, start from0; old overflow not restored

event_schema.identity_note: origin_action_id is original deployment create action, while root_action_id is current triggering root; preserve both for background events
event_schema.source_count: distinct qualifying source keys, never instances, hits, templates equipped or gear count
event_schema.status_alias: STATUS_APPLIED(status_id,accepted_stacks,credited_source_body_id,source_template_id)；FUSION_APPLIED是fusion_burst的同一event_id特化视图，不新增事件或触发；RESONANCE_OFFSET_APPLIED映射shock_offset或tune_offset；havoc_bane为有限异常标记，非未定义第三常驻数槽。

action_api.legal_actions: return exact payable actions/branches/targets, printed costs, and blocked reasons without mutation/RNG/XP; zero legal cards still end_turn/retreat
action_api.action_id_scope: unique within battle; payload canonical SHA256; accepted and rejected receipts persisted
action_api.idempotency: same action_id + same canonical payload returns original receipt, zero new events/RNG/revision/XP; same action_id different payload -> ID_PAYLOAD_CONFLICT; new action_id is legitimate new attempt, not technical duplicate
action_api.revision: new action must expected_revision==current; stale returns STALE_REVISION and no effect; same-id retry checked before revision check
transaction: snapshot cost and source; create resolving card
run ordered effects and queue; removed/invalid targets follow declared fallback, never newly invented target
emit ledger with actual values; check death after each atomic damage/heal group
dispose card once; accrue pending skill XP once if successful non-mode skill use
commit events, receipt, state and revision+1 atomically
action_api.invalid: no cards moved, costs paid, RNG advance or XP; reject receipt stored, game revision unchanged
action_api.rollback: implementation exception or semantic trigger-cycle error rolls back complete root action and returns ENGINE_FAULT; cannot continue candidate run as valid

target_rules.target_spec: self_body, one_enemy, all_enemies, one_ally_body, all_allies, or fixed_entity; role template never heal target
target_rules.select: player commits target ids before payment; exact current validity required
target_rules.multi_target: stable entity_id order; duplicate target IDs illegal
target_rules.dead_mid_action: later hits to dead fixed target fizzle; no automatic retarget unless definition explicitly says next_living
target_rules.self_hp_cost: cannot pay lethal HP cost unless action declares sacrificial and terminal semantics; common candidates initially forbid sacrificial HP costs

combat_math.attack: body base ATK + one weapon flat ATK + explicitly equipped Echo flat ATK; no ATK from template count
combat_math.raw_damage: floor(ATK * effect_coefficient_bp * skill_scale_bp / 100000000); then add explicit flat damage once
combat_math.modifiers: 装备bonus lane内不同effect_id相加、同stacking_key只一份，上限+5000bp；角色明确来源的source_damage lane上限+10000bp，不与装备混成一份。之后source_damage、equipment_bonus、vulnerability、resistance按序乘算，各乘区后floor，不对同lane每条效果分别floor。超过对应上限记录截断，不隐性转资源。
combat_math.defense: post-modifier damage=floor(raw * 100/(100+max(0,DEF))); benchmark DEF=0, future DEF uses same formula
mitigation_order: predict damage after current shield and block without consuming them
if shared proof has lethal_save and predicted HP damage lethal: reserve lethal_save; otherwise cap_hit may truncate to0.30maxHP
consume shield oldest first then block using resulting damage
if lethal_save reserved, limit residual HP damage to hp-1
apply HP damage; consume at most one proof token; apply its declared removal heal once while alive
combat_math.block: additive nonnegative, no implicit reflect/energy; generic D floor(0.8ATK*skillscale)
combat_math.heal: floor(ATK*heal_coefficient_bp*skillscale/1e8), clamp missingHP; overheal discarded; HEAL_APPLIED only ifactual_heal>0; dead cannot heal
combat_math.shield: separate finite status; same source_key replaces larger/current definition policy, never stacks by template copy; expires stated round/use
combat_math.protection_optional: 选cap_hit、lethal_save或共享一令牌的combined，候选必须冻结。cap_hit对合格大额击在盾/格挡前截断至0.30maxHP并消费；若伤害不超阈值不消费。lethal_save依据常规免疫/减伤/盾/格挡之后的预测HP伤害是否致死，致死时剩余HP=1并消费。combined先按无proof的预测检查致死，若致死只用lethal_save，否则若超过大额阈值才用cap_hit。同击只消费一次，不是若干限伤再附送免死。自然到期不治疗；实际消费才可有一次已声明治疗。同来源每战最多授予一次。
combat_math.death: HP<=0 emitsTARGET_DIED once, alive=false; remove dead owner future primary actions, no implicit revival. In simultaneous damage group evaluate all then deaths; player dead and last enemy dead same group -> defeat unless objective definition explicitly pre-registered alternate. Before terminal, no after-death normal healing.
combat_math.terminal: stop pending discretionary triggers after terminal; finalize XP/receipt exactly once; outcome victory/defeat/retreat/stalemate separate
combat_math.healing_modifiers: 治疗基础值先乘装备healing lane（上限+5000bp），最后按缺失生命截断；实际0治疗不触发HEAL_APPLIED。

fusion.apply: explicit tagged effect accepts min(amount,cap-current), positive accepted increments and qualifying event; cap extension does not add stacks
fusion.detonate: explicit effect requires>=1, consumes all once; damage coefficient=4000bp per consumed stack, using triggering ability owner ATK; emitsFUSION_DETONATED notFUSION_APPLIED; no recursive reapply from its own damage
fusion.expansion: single nonstacking+2cap source; lifetime until next detonation or target death/battle_end, overwrite does not add; consumed with detonation; zero stacks may retain expansion
fusion.damage_class: anomaly, not direct, cannot satisfy direct-hit listeners

resonance.accumulate: explicit effects saturate0..6; not all damage automatically accumulates
resonance.offset: one target tag SHOCK or TUNE with source; applying same refreshes no extra count, different replaces; lasts to nextbreak/death/battle_end
resonance.break: explicit effect requires progress6, consumes6; deals1.0ATK break damage. If existing offset, consumes it and emits corresponding INTERFERENCE_DAMAGE using an additional0.5ATK damage; only its actualhp_lost>0 qualifies shock contributor; no offset -> break only
resonance.control: break cancels current intent only if intent.interruptible=true; otherwise just stated damage; no universal stall

public_target_states.named_marks: at most2 extra named mark/deployment references per target; source effects define qualifyingdirect/anomaly events and finiteuses; cannot implement every source mark as additional unbounded counter
public_target_states.direct_damage: root player/npc skill hit with tagdirect; multi-hit one qualifying listener use per root_action/target; equipmentproc, anomaly,DOT and deploymenttick are not direct unless specifically pre-registered as a direct ability, never inferred from positive damage

control_types.delay: once per intent, moves unchanged intent to next round and replaces current with visiblewait; no repeatedpermanent delay
control_types.interrupt: cancels interruptible current intent; next round follows catalogue policy
control_types.reposition: requires movable target and relevant position model; base benchmark no grid, cannot invent Boss pull
control_types.cancel: only explicit ability/interrupt permit, no shield equalscancel

generic_anomaly_tag.representation: 占两个额外标记配额之一的布尔/一次机会状态；共同基线不维护额外虚湮数槽
generic_anomaly_tag.apply: 不存在时accepted_stacks=1；已有且未消耗时重复附加accepted_stacks=0，不叠加/刷新，不再触发装备；实际产生的后续效果由已学千咲技能卡式定义
generic_anomaly_tag.lifetime: 最多1个后续合格根行动机会或2轮，较早者结束；消耗后可由新合法行动重施
generic_anomaly_tag.no_defaults: 标记本身不自动造成伤害；候选必须明确其直接/异常触发及效果，不能实现者猜测

listener_order: learned inherent by stable definition id
ownership_and_trigger_order.event_queue: FIFO breadth-first; events within effect ordered by effect list and targetentityid; listeners create new events appended; no recursive immediate execution
ownership_and_trigger_order.no_self_trigger: listener cannot react to its own descendant effect type unless named acyclic transition allowed; no CONCERTO_GAINED->concerto or heal->same heal chain

limits.meaning: engineering fault detection, not free truncation/player cooldown; any valid intended combo hitting limit fails complexity gate and must be redesigned before qualification

ownership_and_trigger_order.next_template_grant: bind benefit_template_id=actual to_template at qualified handoff; does not follow arbitrarycurrent. Consume only on matching named event; default expires on beneficiaryswitch-out or nextplayerturnend, whichever first. Originating own template later re-entry does not recreate consumed grant.
ownership_and_trigger_order.deaths: already happened historical contribution remains; field future effects require field declared persist_after_owner_death, common defaultfalse

growth.initial: 仅实际取得的规则可用：通用A/D原有；首次模态附内在A/D映射与必要基础私池，不是赠专属主动或两固有。高级学习与外部凭证分开。
growth.xp_validity: one per successfully committed root action per actually used skill, including legitimate repeat/failoutcome; technicalretry zero; passiveauto/deploymenttick gives no new skill-use XP; defensiveusemay count even if opponent laterdoesnotattack
growth.xp_application: collect battle pending XP ledger; commit at battleend on victory/defeat/retreat/stalemate; effective battle skill snapshot stays fixed till nextbattle to avoid midactionlevel shifts
growth.normal_progression: levels1..8: each100 increments1 carryoverflow; level9withoutheartflag mayreach100 andcap, discardextra; level9withheartflag reaches100 ->10; level10XP=0, no furthergrowth
growth.plus_one_item: outofbattle target anylearnedskill level<10, upgrade exactly1 withoutXP/materialcondition; retain existing0..99XP where level<10, clearXP at10. Doesnotlearnskill, doesnotunlocktemplatewidecap; target10/unlearned rejected with noitemspent
growth.heart_demon_receipt: idempotent fixed_target_victory token grants targetrole qualification flag; existing9and100skills immediately10; otherslevels/XPunchanged; future normal growth canreach10. Onefixedvictoryreceipt cannot granttwice orconsumeotherroleitem
